subject: Clearline MAP: path-to-prod timeline & technical leads
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>
To: Sana Patel <sana.patel@clearline.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 08 Jul 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff: Clearline evaluation & timeline

Hi Sana —

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday. Per our call, I’m sharing a first draft of a mutual action plan (attached) so we can align on stakeholders, success criteria, and a realistic path to a production evaluation. Quick intro of roles on our side:

- Marcus Lin — Solutions Engineer (technical lead for evaluation + runbooks)
- Me (Laura Bennett) — Account Executive (commercial owner, sequencing & timelines)
- Aditya Rao — Sales Engineering Manager (escalation/contact for SLAs)

What we’d like to confirm from you:
- Primary technical contact for the evaluation (engineering lead)
- Procurement/contact for contracting & timing
- Any hard dates you’re targeting for an internal demo or pilot close

Proposed high-level timeline (flexible):
- Week 0 (this week): Kickoff meeting, finalize stakeholders, share test prompts/dataset
- Week 1: Rapid eval run (throughput/latency + quality checks), Redwood config recommendations
- Week 2: Pilot adjustments, quantization/latency tuning, cost estimate update
- Week 4: Go/no-go decision and contracting (if positive)

Attached: MAP_v1_ClearlineAI.xlsx (mutual action plan v1) and SOC2_evidence_stub.pdf for initial security references.

Suggested agenda for the kickoff call (30–45 min):
- Introductions & roles (5 min)
- Clearline goals + acceptance criteria (5–10 min)
- Technical checklist: dataset, qps, seq len, SSO/data flow (10 min)
- Next steps & owners (10 min)

Can you confirm the right engineering contact and share two windows that work for a 30–45m kickoff later this week?

Thanks — looking forward to partnering.

Best,

Laura Bennett
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.inference

Laura — thanks, and appreciate the clear plan.

Our technical lead for this project will be Devon Lee (devon.lee@clearline.ai). Procurement is Tom Brooks (tbrooks@clearline.ai); I’ll loop him in once we lock the timeline.

High-level goals from our side:
- Confirm throughput target: 75 QPS sustained (95th pct latency target < 200ms for 512-token requests)
- Validate inference cost at target QPS + quantization tradeoffs
- Ensure no sensitive PII leaves our VPC during eval (we can provide a masked sample dataset)

We can do a kickoff Thu Jul 9 at 11:00 AM PT or Fri Jul 10 at 09:00 AM PT — either works for Devon. Please pick one and send an invite.

Also: we prefer a concise acceptance criteria block in the MAP (latency qps/cost + quality pass rate). Can Marcus propose measurement definitions?

Thanks — Sana
Sana Patel
Head of Product | Clearline AI
sana.patel@clearline.ai

Hi Sana —

Thanks for confirming Devon. I’ll take point on the technical acceptance criteria and propose the measurement plan below for the kickoff. Quick agenda I’ll bring to the call if we pick Thu 9/11:

Proposed technical agenda (Marcus)
- Measurement definitions: how we’ll measure latency (p50/p95), throughput (sustained QPS), and quality (exact-match/validated prompts)
- Data: what masked sample set you can provide + how we’ll handle KV cache / prefix caching for repeated prompts
- Workload profile: average & peak sequence length, payload size, expected traffic pattern (burstiness)
- Configs to test: FP16 / 8-bit quantized variant, batching strategy, model variants (standard vs latency-optimized)
- Telemetry: token-level latency breakdown, OOM handling, and logs we’ll collect for post-run analysis

A couple of asks to prepare before kickoff:
- Short sample of 10–20 representative prompts (can be redacted)
- A rough QPS target window (you mentioned 75 QPS; is that steady-state or peak?)
- Any inbound/outbound network restrictions (VPC peering, non-routable endpoints)

I’ve attached a short evaluation checklist (one-pager) to the meeting invite I’ll send once we confirm time. I’ll also propose concrete pass/fail thresholds for the pilot so we can update the MAP with clear acceptance criteria.

Quick note on data residency: if you want the pilot to run in a dedicated VPC with customer-controlled keys, we can surface Private deployment options — happy to coordinate after the kickoff.

Thanks — I’ll send a calendar invite for Thu Jul 9 11:00 AM PT unless I hear otherwise.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.inference

I’ve attached a short stakeholder list (roles + emails) and a redacted sample of 15 prompts we’ll use in the pilot. Please:

- Update the MAP v1 with the measurement definitions Marcus proposed (latency p50/p95, sustained 75 QPS target, cost per 1M tokens).

We’ll expect a one-page runbook after the kickoff outlining how Redwood plans to run the eval, expected telemetry, and the rollback criteria. If you can get an updated MAP doc into the HubSpot deal record before the call, that’d be ideal.
